purpose: Separate the cost of runtime card selection from the marginal value of selected voice cards.

arms.name: dynamic
arms.mechanism: Current --list-tags followed by select_voice_cards.py at runtime; include the selected cards.

arms.name: static-equivalent
arms.mechanism: Lookup the canonical scene/domain pair in the committed static map; include exactly the same card IDs as A without a selector subprocess.

arms.name: no-cards
arms.mechanism: Use the same slim kernel and routed domain references, omitting selector and voice cards.

contrasts.A_vs_B: Runtime selector and tool-round-trip cost, holding card IDs constant.
contrasts.B_vs_C: Marginal semantic and voice value of the cards without selector cost.
contrasts.A_vs_C: Cost and value of the complete current card package.

pilot.order: For repetition r and case index i, rotate [A, B, C] by (r + i) mod 3.

cases.reason: Architecture review where a concise corrective voice may help.
Diagnosis/review with an explicit uncertainty boundary.
Substantial Russian documentation and contract explanation.
Short factual/status response; selector should not materially participate.
Short precise language-contract answer; selector should not materially participate.

metrics.reporting: Report completion and censoring separately; compare paired observations by case, repetition, and arm order.

decision_criteria.static_replacement: Prefer B over A only if B is non-inferior on primary metrics and applicable voice/language axes while reducing selector tool calls and/or elapsed time.
decision_criteria.remove_cards: Prefer C over B only if no primary or applicable voice/language metric shows a material degradation; otherwise retain cards.
decision_criteria.material_degradation: Pre-register any numerical threshold in the review before model runs; this design does not treat a single pilot as proof of equivalence.

requirements: checkpoint one observation at a time
